support.cardHint: We usually reply within one business day.
support.q1: Why is my location shown as approximate?
support.a1: Your location is shared rounded to ~1 km: enough to compute a fair midpoint, not enough to give away your address.
support.q2: What does my friend see when they open the link?
support.a2: The meet-up name, the activity and the display names of everyone in it. They join without downloading an app or creating an account.
support.a3: No. Audio flows directly between devices and is never recorded anywhere.
support.q4: How do I delete my data?
support.a4: Account and data → Delete account. You can also do it at bumpinto.app/account/delete without installing the app.
support.dsa: Published under Article 30 of the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).
